School task: Compare and contrast life in Ancient Athens and Ancient Sparta. Include details from both texts.

POWER Color Code

T Topic
I Important Evidence
D Detailed Explanation
E Ending
Athens & Sparta · 比较文本 / POWER框架click to zoom

Example 2 Draft

Click each sentence to cycle through T / I / D / E labels. Guess first, don't worry about being perfect.
Athens and Sparta were both places in Ancient Greece. They were city-states and people lived there a long time ago. Athens was busy and had people trading. Boys learned things like reading and math. Sparta was different because boys had to train to be soldiers when they were young. They had to be tough. Women in Sparta could do more things that women in Athens. Athens and Sparta were kind of alike, but they also had different ways of living.

Fact Sorter

Click each card to sort it into Athens / Both / Sparta.
People traded and the city was busy.
Boys trained to be soldiers from a young age.
Both were city-states in Ancient Greece.
Boys learned reading and math.
Women had more freedom than in Athens.
People lived there a long time ago.
Yellow = evidence (facts from text); Orange = explanation (what the fact shows). Some sentences may have both.

Choose 1 question from the Energy Bus Stop below. First say it out loud, then write one sentence.

Energy Bus Stop · SEL问题click to zoom

1. Happy or Included

Who did you help feel happy or included today, and what did you do?

2. Kindness Tomorrow

Was there someone who needed kindness today? How could you help them tomorrow?

3. Kindness to Me

How did someone show kindness to you today, and how did it make you feel?

4. Replay

If you could replay one moment from today, is there anything you would do differently to be a better friend or classmate?

5. Better Classroom

What is one kind thing you want to do tomorrow to help make your classroom a better place for everyone?
